facts.fact: The article states that businesses with a monthly ad spend of at least $200,000 can benefit from CTV without compromising other marketing efforts.
facts.quote: Businesses with a monthly ad spend of at least $200,000 can benefit from CTV without compromising other marketing efforts.

facts.fact: Keynes Digital's Chris Chen advises that advertisers spending at least $200,000 a month can allocate a small 10-15% budget to CTV without putting the business in financial harm's way.
facts.quote: Advertisers that are spending at least $200,000 a month can allocate a small 10-15% budget without putting the business in financial harm's way.

facts.fact: Keynes Digital's Chris Chen says the firm will insert 15- and 30-second non-skippable ads during premium content when it can.
facts.quote: If we can insert 15- and 30-second non-skippable ads during premium content, we'll do it," says Chen.

facts.fact: The article states that both 15-second and 30-second CTV spots are effective, depending on the complexity of the message.
facts.quote: Both 15-second and 30-second spots are effective, depending on the complexity of the message.

facts.fact: Keynes Digital's Chris Chen says CTV spots with a persistent URL are important because viewers may not give a 30-second ad their full attention.
facts.quote: CTV spots that have a persistent URL are really important... you may not have someone's 30 seconds of full, undivided attention.

facts.fact: The article advises ensuring CTV ads are placed in the first slot of commercial breaks to capture maximum attention.
facts.quote: Ensure ads are placed in the first slot of commercial breaks to capture maximum attention.

facts.fact: Keynes Digital, according to the article, focuses predominantly on CTV advertising for performance marketers who use an audience-first approach.
facts.quote: Keynes Digital focuses predominantly on CTV advertising for performance marketers who are used to an audience-first approach

facts.fact: Chris Chen says Keynes Digital's model is ad tech plus agency with a very cost-efficient model that eschews traditional agency fees.
facts.quote: CTV eschews traditional agency fees, offering a more budget-friendly advertising model.
